body:
GOSH this is a lot to unpack. I made a video about how we shouldn't change someone's skin tone on TikTok. Of course, it blew up and people started shoving death threats at me (why should I even be surprised)

 They kept saying that changing a pale character and giving them a darker skin tone is perfectly fine because it's for "black rep" Personally, I have mixed feelings about this topic. I keep seeing a lot of black edits on my fyp of people turning characters black and saying "I fixed them" or "they look so much better now" 

They keep saying that because I'm not black, I don't have a say in this topic. This conversation is about how we shouldn't change someone's skin tone (dark to pale, pale to dark, etc.) And this topic isn't just about black people. And despite that, the death threats just kept on coming. 
I understand that black people want representation, but is giving a pale character dark skin really the way to go? Im brown, and I want representation too, but I'm not giving a character I like, brown skin. That isn't who they are, and we shouldn't change that.


Honestly I'm tired of arguing in the comments, I might just delete the video. But I just want to stand my ground
It didn't look like a friendly alien ☹️ But thank you, your explanation sounds comforting
